model.second_shard_storage: Verified immutable hardlink to the identical existing Q2_0 second shard
model.draft_pack: Existing separate MTP pack for the same checkpoint; target remains the official IQ3_S GGUF

writing.text: Write a 300-word short story about an engineer repairing a clock on a rainy evening. Include a clear ending.

coding.text: Source token fixture is bench/results/2026-10-03-sycl-mtp-floor/strata-sycl-profile-coding-tokens.txt; requests a Python merge of two sorted integer lists.

arithmetic.text: What is 2+2? Reply with just the number.

measurement_scope: Nineteen fresh persistent engine processes, six requests each: two 128-token writing requests, two 128-token coding requests, writing cancelled after its first token, eight-token writing recovery. Three complete uniform/compact pairs ran in alternating order after the screens. Decode timers exclude startup and prompt processing; first requests include lazy graph preparation. Repeated requests retain expert-cache contents and reuse prompt tokens. Background workloads were active and not isolated; all samples are retained.

sycl_tests.note: All existing SYCL tests after adding IQ formats; changed host-engine test separately passed after slot sizing.

slot_storage_comparison.scope: Fixed 1649 per-layer cache slots, no adaptation; all full-vocabulary window rows including rejected proposals before/after compact slot storage.

cpu_model_reference.scope: One 25-token rendered arithmetic chat, teacher-forced one token at a time, FP16 KV; pinned llama.cpp CPU-only reference. Not a broad quality gate or bitwise-equivalence assertion.
cpu_model_reference.condition_correction: The original sycl_cache_off label was incorrect: --expert-cache 0 with --expert-profile selects automatic sizing, which allocated 2530 slots in this run. Original numerical results are retained under sycl_cache_auto; a true cache-off check is recorded in the post-rebase summary.

ordinary_decode.scope: Cross-mode output equality is not claimed.

q2_regression.scope: Existing Q2_0 config after adding mixed-format per-layer slots; first 16 ids retain the prior fixture.

upstream_snapshot.phase: Before upstream synchronization through PR #1 and rebase; historical measurement metadata.

limitations: Short fixed fixtures on this one machine; not a broad quality evaluation or matched NVIDIA benchmark.
CPU, GPU and single/multi-token arithmetic differ; cache/floor/worker/mode changes may change continuations.
Only fixed-placement storage optimization is asserted bitwise exact; changing automatic residency is a separate configuration.
Long contexts, complete vision pipeline, Windows and additional model variants have not been validated here.
